note: Status tracker for instruments the Aquatic Guardian module is designed to attach to. 'verify' marks facts with conflicting or secondary sources. Update through pull requests with a primary-source link.

instruments.name: AI Data Center Moratorium Act (S.4214)

dates.event: Introduced by Sen. Sanders; referred to Senate Commerce, Science, and Transportation

instruments.hook: DOE facility reporting already names 'wastewater discharge and thermal outputs' and 'cooling chemicals used'; definition covers liquid cooling.
instruments.action: Define the thermal, intake and biology metrics; add submerged and seawater-cooled facilities to the definition; define 'harm the environment' to include sentient aquatic animals.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: AI Data Center Moratorium Act (H.R.9442)

dates.event: Introduced by Rep. Ocasio-Cortez; referred to Energy and Commerce and Foreign Affairs

instruments.hook: House companion to S.4214 with the same reporting duty.
instruments.action: Same definitional amendments as S.4214; also package as a stand-alone transparency amendment.
instruments.verify_note: Cosponsor count differs between sources (13 vs 14).

instruments.name: Executive Order 14318, Accelerating Federal Permitting of Data Center Infrastructure
instruments.hook: NEPA categorical exclusions do not waive ESA §7, MMPA, EFH, CZMA consistency or CWA §316.
instruments.action: Publish a checklist of statutory consultations that still apply to coastal and submerged projects.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: Clean Water Act §316(a) and §316(b), 40 CFR Part 125
instruments.hook: §316(b) already counts impinged and entrained organisms; a once-through data centre above ~3-4 MW likely exceeds the 2 MGD trigger.
instruments.action: EPA guidance confirming §316(b) applies to data centres; add taxon, life-stage and tier fields to monitoring reports.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: AB 93 (data centre water-use disclosure)

dates.event: Vetoed; SB 57 (data centre energy) signed the same day

instruments.hook: A reintroduced disclosure bill is the obvious California vehicle.
instruments.action: Reintroduce with the Aquatic Disclosure metric set; apply Once-Through Cooling Policy logic to seawater-cooled data centres.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: WAC 173-201A (surface water quality standards)
instruments.hook: Marine 1-DMax categories and the 12/(T-2) point-source increment at the mixing-zone edge.
instruments.action: Ecology mixing-zone approvals for data centres use critical conditions and report sentience-tier biology.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: EU data centre sustainability rating scheme (Delegated Regulation amending 2024/1364)
instruments.status: Adopted by Commission; in Parliament and Council scrutiny
instruments.hook: Labels built from Article 12 EED reporting for data centres >= 500 kW; review adds indicators.
instruments.action: Propose a thermal-discharge-to-surface-water indicator for the 2028 review.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: Consultation on minimum performance standards for data centres
instruments.hook: Binding floor for data centres; legislative proposal expected spring 2027.
instruments.action: Submit the Aquatic Guardian consultation response (draft in repository).
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: Cloud and AI Development Act, COM(2026) 502
instruments.hook: Acceleration zones with 12-month permitting that cover water abstraction, wastewater discharge and heat authorisations.
instruments.action: Amend zone designation criteria to require Water Framework and Habitats Directive thermal and intake screening first.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: Energieeffizienzgesetz (EnEfG) data centre requirements

dates.event: PUE <= 1.2 and ERF >= 10% for new data centres

instruments.action: Credit aquaculture reuse toward ERF only with a named welfare standard.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: Energy Statutes Amendment Act, 2025 (Bill 31) and BC Hydro calls for power / demand
instruments.status: In force; Call for Power EPAs awarded; Call for Demand notifications delayed

dates.event: 2025 Call for Power: four Electricity Purchase Agreements awarded (~3,500 GWh/year)
2026 Call for Demand (AI/data centres) supplemental-application deadline

instruments.hook: Competitive allocation of clean power and emerging-industry load (AI/data centres), scored partly on environmental impact and First Nations involvement.
instruments.action: Add an aquatic-impact sub-score and a closed-loop heat-reuse credit to the next call, co-developed with First Nations.
instruments.verify_note: 2025 Call for Power results announced 13 May 2026 (BC Hydro participants page). 2026 Call for Demand: 15 applications (~800 MW); applicants moving to the next stage notified; final outcome notifications delayed past mid-September 2026 pending government transition (BC Hydro emerging-industries page, checked 2026-10-17).

instruments.name: Fisheries Act s.34-36 and s.35
instruments.hook: 'Deleterious substance' expressly includes water changed by heat; s.35 covers habitat damage.
instruments.action: DFO guidance confirming heated cooling water is within s.36; authorisation conditions for intakes.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: AI Sovereign Compute Infrastructure Program and AI Compute Challenge
instruments.action: Attach aquatic disclosure and heat-reuse conditions to funded facilities.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: BBNJ Agreement (High Seas Treaty)
instruments.hook: EIA obligations beyond national jurisdiction; relevant to floating or high-seas compute.
instruments.action: COP-1 submission asking for guidance on continuous heat-rejecting infrastructure.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: ISO/IEC 30134 data centre KPIs
instruments.hook: WUE covers consumptive freshwater only; nothing covers heat to water or intake biology.
instruments.action: Propose a technical report on thermal-discharge and intake KPIs to ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 39.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.

instruments.name: Animal Welfare (Sentience) Act 2022 and Animal Sentience Committee
instruments.hook: Committee scrutinises government policy for effects on vertebrates, cephalopods and decapods; data centres are Critical National Infrastructure.
instruments.action: Request a Committee review of data-centre siting and cooling policy.
instruments.verify_note: Needs a primary-source URL before this status can be treated as verified.
